key.doc: The item one call costs: one key per banner (Docs/features/10-heroes.md §5).

heroChanceByOwned.doc: The chance a call brings a whole hero, by how many heroes the player owns: the first entry with none, the last for that many and more. Soft pity ramps from it (Docs/features/10-heroes.md §6.6).

duplicateFragments.doc: Fragments a hero already held turns into, when a call hits them again.

showsHero.doc: The store's Heroes tab stands a hero on this banner: one of the rarest rarity it can call, a different one each time the store is opened, every one before any repeats. Off: the banner shows its key.

featuredHero.doc: The season hero this banner leans toward: while it is set, that hero is open in the player's bag over the count, until recruited (Docs/features/10-heroes.md §6.6). Empty for none.

extraHeroSlotChance.doc: The share of calls whose hero-goods prize is a second hero prize instead: one more Fragment of a hero in the bag. Never a second hit (Docs/features/10-heroes.md §6.4).

loot.doc: What a call pays, one prize per slot, each a weighted draw from its slot's rows: Fragments are the hero slot (on a miss), Stardust and HeroXp the hero-goods slot, Items the supplies slot (Docs/features/10-heroes.md §6.4).

reward.doc: Fragments: of one hero of `rarity` in the bag — the hero slot. Stardust, HeroXp: into the wallet — the hero-goods slot. Item: `item` into the Bag — the supplies slot.

rarity.doc: Fragments: whose. Empty for anything else.

item.doc: Item: which. Empty for anything else.

weight.doc: Its share of its slot's draws, against the other rows of that slot.
